description: Fires most strongly when the opponent has three stones stacked vertically at the top of column 2 (the third column from the left) with the cell above empty, i.e. a vertical must-block in column 2, usually just created; vertical threats in column 3 fire more weakly and other columns rarely. Weaker when I have my own immediate win. Most threshold-level firing (about 70%) is diffuse, often opening positions, and is not captured.
effect: None measurable: forcing it to max or zero changes move probabilities by at most about 0.02 (one position 0.1).
notes: Top band (99.9%) is almost all column-2 vertical opponent threes. Rules: col2 vertical F1 0.295; any-column vertical 0.20; col2/3 vertical 0.315; minus own-win 0.316 (P 0.47, R 0.24). Early last-move-in-col-2 and opening terms lowered F1. Simulation share 0.00 at every attempt; steer shows no effect. Rest of firing looks diffuse. Synthesis reaches 5.45 vs dev max 5.02.
